items.title: Wallet GUID fact identity can exceed accepted Statistics identifier limit
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-01: StatisticsConfigCodec accepts maxStatisticIdLength below 36; Wallet emits 36-character TransactionId GUID as FactIdentity.EventId; StatisticsModule rejects it after the Wallet commit, losing the required received-currency fact.

items.title: Statistics config budget omits declared EventId dedupe ledger capacity
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-02: accepted aggregate budget reserves only MaxDedupSources structural bytes and omits MaxEventIdsPerSource plus identifier storage, allowing declared valid traffic capacity to exceed MaxProviderEncodedBytes.

items.title: README initialization diagrams drift from canonical manifests
items.evidence: review-tf0003-arch-01: README server/client initialization order omits or misorders Teleport, TeleportValidationPad, and Statistics relative to ServerManifest, ClientManifest, and current system documentation.

items.title: AutoSave requested-save bookkeeping lacks controller unregistration
items.evidence: review-tf0003-verify-02: removed controllers remain retained by autosave entries/maps/connections because no unregister/removal lifecycle clears new requested-save state, violating bounded cleanup expectations.
